'''Zac Wyant''' is a Star Wars CCG player. They finished 6th in [[DecipherCon 1999 Gauntlet]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]]<ref name="dc99sw30_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW30_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: The Gauntlet Dual Format], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000602202806/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW30_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>.
